tasks.short: Develop and implement scientific or technical policies, standards and procedures.

steps.what: Map current technical procedures to actual obligations using native versioned policy views
inputs: actual applicable obligations and current technical procedures
outputs: manager-checked procedure obligations and gaps

steps.what: Develop actual scientific work policies, standards or procedures and judge operational consequences
inputs: manager-checked procedure obligations and gaps
actual scientific operations and delegated authority
outputs: manager-developed technical procedure and implementation choices

steps.what: Write and approve complete final technical procedures, implementation instructions and exact staff recipients
inputs: manager-developed technical procedure and implementation choices
outputs: approved final technical procedure and implementation instructions with exact staff recipients

steps.what: Commit the approved final technical procedure version
inputs: approved final technical procedure and implementation instructions with exact staff recipients
outputs: actual committed technical procedure version

steps.what: Send the approved final technical procedure and implementation instructions to approved staff
inputs: approved final technical procedure and implementation instructions with exact staff recipients
outputs: delivered final technical procedure instructions

steps.what: Oversee actual procedure implementation and address practical scientific work exceptions
inputs: delivered final technical procedure instructions
actual staff use and implementation observations
outputs: actual technical procedure implementation findings

steps.what: Write and approve actual implementation findings and remaining procedure gaps
inputs: actual technical procedure implementation findings
outputs: approved final actual procedure implementation note

steps.what: Save the approved actual procedure implementation note
inputs: approved final actual procedure implementation note
outputs: saved actual implementation note

tasks.design: Configure native obligation and procedure version views in {DOCS}. The manager develops actual technical procedures and approves the complete final version before separate commit and internal instruction send. Actual implementation is observed before its actual note is written, approved and separately saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual obligations and procedure versions may be repeatedly reconciled by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned policy mappings can expose actual procedure dependencies and gaps.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific suitability, actual applicability and practical implementation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows when a formally complete procedure fails in scientific work.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated obligation mapping with procedure decisions retained.

evidence.claim: Versioned policy libraries and obligation mapping exist; this technical procedure configuration is proposed.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify residual mapping after current policy tools; existing approval routing and runtime earn no saving.
Actual approved sources supply obligation_id, scope, procedure_id and version. s1 retains 10 hours for applicability and gap checking; missing source links use manual reconciliation.

Development, writing, implementation and actual findings capture retain full effort. Every complete final artefact exists before its action approval. Changed text or recipients void approval. No legal compliance or actual implementation is inferred from a sent procedure. Same-system commits and saves earn no benefit.

tasks.short: Oversee development or maintenance of staff competence, or recruit personnel.

inputs: actual scientific work requirements
actual staff competence records
outputs: manager-identified staff competence review scope

steps.what: Reconcile actual training completions and qualification evidence using native competence views
inputs: manager-identified staff competence review scope
actual training and qualification records
outputs: manager-checked competence evidence and missing records

steps.what: Judge actual development needs and choose suitable competence support or supervision
inputs: manager-checked competence evidence and missing records
actual work observation and staff circumstances
outputs: manager-chosen competence support priorities

steps.what: Discuss actual competence development with staff and oversee practical learning support
inputs: manager-chosen competence support priorities
actual staff explanations and development activity
outputs: actual competence discussion and support observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual competence support notes and observed learning limitations
inputs: actual competence discussion and support observations
outputs: approved final actual staff competence note

steps.what: Save the approved actual staff competence note
inputs: approved final actual staff competence note
outputs: saved actual staff competence note

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} and {TALENT} views for actual qualification and completion evidence. The manager judges development needs and oversees actual staff support personally, then writes actual observations. The complete final note is approved before its separate save; no automated competence rating or employment decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual completion and qualification evidence may be manually reconciled across learning records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native competence views can expose actual recorded completions and source evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Judging practical scientific competence and providing useful development support.
tasks.human_edge: The manager distinguishes a recorded completion from demonstrated competence.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated competence evidence reconciliation with human staff development retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning systems support actual qualification and completion views; this competence evidence configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. The worked branch is the statement competence-development alternative, including actual staff discussion and written records. No recruitment saving is inferred. Verify residual evidence reconciliation after current learning views; existing reports and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual training records already supply staff_id, qualification_id, completion_date and evidence_id. s1 captures actual review scope at full time; s2 retains 10 hours for currency and missing evidence checks. Missing records use manual verification; no free new trainer capture is assumed.
Judgement, support and actual note writing remain full effort. Final note approval follows actual discussion and precedes save. Changes void approval; same-system save earns no benefit.

tasks.short: Prepare and administer budgets, review expenditures and prepare financial reports.

steps.what: Verify actual scientific project costs, commitments, funding and budget assumptions
inputs: actual ledger, commitments and project plans
outputs: manager-checked budget source set and assumptions

steps.what: Prepare budget scenarios using native project and cost-centre budget templates
inputs: manager-checked budget source set and assumptions
outputs: manager-checked complete candidate budget

steps.what: Choose and approve the complete final budget within actual delegated spending authority
inputs: manager-checked complete candidate budget
outputs: approved final budget and exact project cost centres

steps.what: Post the approved final budget to the approved project cost centres
inputs: approved final budget and exact project cost centres
outputs: actual posted project budget

steps.what: Review actual expenditure requests and approve exact final amounts, coding and justification
inputs: actual posted project budget
actual complete expenditure requests and supporting invoices
outputs: approved final expenditure decision and exact request identifiers

steps.what: Commit the approved final expenditure decision against its exact requests
inputs: approved final expenditure decision and exact request identifiers
outputs: actual saved expenditure approval decisions

steps.what: Assemble exact financial report tables using native project ledger report templates
inputs: actual ledger and commitments
actual posted project budget
actual saved expenditure approval decisions
outputs: candidate exact financial report tables with source references

steps.what: Draft and check financial commentary against actual figures and manager-recorded explanations
inputs: candidate exact financial report tables with source references
manager-checked budget source set and assumptions
outputs: manager-checked complete candidate financial report

loop.purpose: Express actual manager-recorded financial explanations in report prose
loop.input: Actual financial tables and manager explanations only
loop.output: Candidate commentary with source links and unexplained variances explicit
loop.check: Manager verifies every causal explanation, number, qualification and omission against actual ledger and recorded rationale; no cause is invented from a variance
loop.stop: Missing explanation or two failed corrections returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables handle exact figures first; variable actual financial explanations require substantive prose drafting and checking

steps.what: Approve the complete final financial report and exact internal finance recipients
inputs: manager-checked complete candidate financial report
outputs: approved final financial report and exact internal finance recipients

steps.what: Send the approved final financial report to the approved internal finance recipients
inputs: approved final financial report and exact internal finance recipients
outputs: sent final project financial report

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP} budget templates and project ledger report fields using actual {PROJECT} sources. The manager chooses budgets and approves actual expenditures, with each resulting post a separate gated action. Exact report tables and bounded commentary drafting feed full meaning checks and final report approval before a separate internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual project figures may be recopied into budget scenarios and periodic financial reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ERP templates reuse exact figures; bounded drafting rewords actual manager explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Funding tradeoffs, spending authority and explaining actual financial variance.
tasks.human_edge: The manager judges whether expenditure serves the scientific project and whether a variance explanation is justified.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated budget and financial reporting assembly with spending authority retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: ERP budget and report templates plus bounded commentary drafting can reuse actual project records; this is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual budget scenario and report copying after existing ERP reports; existing totals, native approval buttons and runtime earn no saving.

Actual ledger supplies project_id, cost_centre, period, amount, currency and commitment_status. s1 retains full checking and captures actual planning assumptions and variance explanations; s2 retains 12.5 hours for scenario checks. Actual expenditure request owners already supply request_id, amount, coding and supporting evidence; s5 retains full final review. Missing fields use manual preparation, never invented baselines.

s8 retains 6 hours for full commentary meaning checks and s9 final combined approval. Any final budget, expenditure decision, report or destination change voids its approval. Same-system posts earn no benefit. Actual payment execution is not inferred from expenditure approval.
research_questions: Which actual project figures are still recopied after native ERP budget and report templates?

s5 complete final expenditure decisions and exact request identifiers

Scientific interpretation and final writing retain full effort. The complete actual findings exist before approval and save; changed findings void approval. Same-system save earns no benefit. Publication and external acceptance are not inferred.
